svg.text: dbt Platform MCP + Google Gemini Enterprise (A2UI v0.9)
Reference Architecture & Core Use Cases — Prefetch-First 0ms Exploration, Lineage & Guarded Action Loop
Conversational Intent & User OAuth / Tool Approval
• Natural-language entry: "Check failed dbt runs", "Trace orders lineage", "Query revenue"
• Human-in-the-loop "Allow" gate for sensitive tools (e.g., execute_sql, trigger_job_run)
• Concise 2-4 bullet executive summary paired with interactive right-hand Canvas
Instant 0ms tab switching & client-side filtering; Loading Popup prompts user when Chat 'Allow' is needed
Use Case 1: Build Triage, Incident Root-Cause & Job Actions
• 0ms filter across 40 runs (Failed / Active / Succeeded) + inline Refresh on active runs
• Pre-hydrated error logs & failed model detection; Deep Dive loads artifacts & dbt Docs
• Actions: 2-Step Confirmed Safe Retry, Selective Rebuild (+model+), or Cancel Run
Use Case 2: Catalog Health, Source Freshness & Lineage
• dbt Platform multi-rank Bezier DAG; hover path highlight; Tests hidden by default
• Click any model in Lineage -> Model Details (Last Run, Attached Tests, Columns & SQL)
• 1-click Lineage jump from Marts, Sources, Search & Failed Runs + AI Semantic Search
Use Case 3: Governed Semantic Layer & MetricFlow Studio
• Pre-hydrated primary KPI with 0ms toggle: Visual Bars / Data Rows / Compiled SQL
• On-demand MetricFlow slicing by Time Grain (DAY..YEAR) & governed Dimensions
• Empty-state build guidance + 1-click Trigger dbt Build to populate Semantic artifacts
Use Case 4: Governed Jinja SQL Runner & AI NL-to-SQL
• 0ms snippet picker for governed {{ ref() }}, {{ source() }} & project {{ macros() }}
• dbt Copilot text_to_sql generation + 2-step confirmed Warehouse SQL execution
• Actionable remediation if personal dbt Platform Dev Credentials are not configured
• 1-to-1 Event Router maps a2ui_action -> CLI subcommand
In-place Canvas refresh · Zero tab proliferation
• Wave 1 (8x ThreadPool): Projects, Jobs, 40 Runs, Marts,
All Models, Sources, Exposures, Metrics, Saved Queries, Macros
(with SemanticModel) + Node Details, Primary Metric slice
• Extra MCP calls run ONLY on user deep-dive requests:
uncached lineage, run artifacts/docs, custom slices, NL-to-SQL
• PII masking + strict allow-listed 24-tool MCP gateway
Google Cloud Secure MCP Connector Bridge
• Agent Workload Identity + Outbound OAuth / PAT injection
• Auto-discovers portable GCP dataConnector & dbt endpoint
• Schema-safe retry guard for strict FastMCP validation
Populated by completed dbt build runs in deployment env
dbt Platform SQL Gateway & dbt Copilot
Compiles {{ ref() }} / {{ source() }} & executes using user's
personal Development Credentials configured in dbt Platform
Executes dbt build pipelines, MetricFlow semantic SQL,
and governed ad-hoc queries with enterprise IAM & lineage
